ticker_news.title: Broadcom Shares Surge as It Adds More Custom AI Chip Customers. Can the Momentum in the Stock Continue?
ticker_news.description: Broadcom's shares surged after the company reported record revenue and said it was developing custom AI chips for major customers. The company's addressable market for these chips could reach $60-$90 billion by 2027, but there are some concerns about potential customer losses and the impact of TikTok's uncertain future.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool
